messages:
Sam (Design): quick heads-up from usability testing: on compact table rows the swipe-to-reveal actions are getting blocked by toasts that appear during the gesture. folks accidentally dismiss or trigger toasts while trying to hit row actions.
Eli - Eng: ouch. which page and device?
Sam (Design): Activity -> Audit Logs, iPhone 8 width, swipe left on a row to reveal Delete / Archive. if a background save fires a toast it flashes up under the swipe area and steals taps. gif attached.
Rowan (Design Systems): likely cause: compact token reduced padding, gesture area overlaps toast edge; toast uses pointer-events: auto and fixed positioning. we also have transform on the table container which prevents z-index escape.
Priya (PM): user impact: destructive actions could be triggered or cancelled. also copy on the toast is just "Saved" which is too generic when multiple things can save at once. suggest contextualizing like "Auto-saved audit filter".
Eli - Eng: short-term: set toasts to `pointer-events: none` during touch gestures and add a small debounce so toasts don't appear mid-gesture. longer-term: ensure swipe gesture area is always above toasts by adding a high-level gesture layer with higher stacking context.
Rowan (Design Systems): also add `--gesture-zone` token (min 44px) and a rule that gesture overlays should get `position: fixed` at a top stacking layer. avoid using transform on scroll containers that host interactive popovers.
Sam (Design): accessibility note: keyboard users navigate rows and hit the kebab for actions. the toast sometimes covers the focused state. focus-visible should sit on top of toasts or toasts should avoid focused elements.
Eli - Eng: agreed. implement z-index for `:focus-visible` or have toasts query `document.activeElement` and reposition if a focused element is near the toast.
Priya (PM): small copy tweak: for this screen change default toast text from "Saved" -> "Filters saved" or "Changes saved to filters" when it originates from the filter component. please make copy contextual where possible.
Rowan (Design Systems): implementation plan: 1) add `--gesture-zone` and `--touch-target-min` tokens, 2) debounce toast display by 200ms if a touch gesture is active, 3) add top-level gesture overlay stacking layer so swipes and focus rings stay above toasts, 4) update tokens docs and add linter for hit-area min.
access-bot: created ticket #UI-1223 "Toast vs gesture overlap" and opened PR `gesture-toast-layer-1815` for review: https://staging.redwood.ai/pr/3102
Eli - Eng: prototyped on staging: debounce + pointer-events toggle works well on iOS and Android. left follow-up to add Percy snapshot for 375px swipe states.
Sam (Design): great. also adding a follow-up to audit other gesture interactions (drag-to-reorder, long-press menus). thanks team :thumbsup:
